page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 289 at top right. Main text in one wide column. Marginal notes in the left margin (marginal letters and small notes, partly illegible on the scan) and a small note at the right margin (ASIATICA, Iosephi / Lib. 13. c. 7.). Section heading "CONTEMPORANEA." centred.

main_text.p: metu fui (rationes enim redituum expofcebat, ad quas Seleucus fe negabat tenere) Babylone ad Ptolemaeum fugientem *, monitu Chaldaeorum, fed fruftra perfecutus eft, & cum ad Lyfimachi, Ptolemaei, & Caffandri poftulata (poftulabant autem, ut Cappadociam & Lyciam Caffandro, Phrygiam juxta Hellefpontum Lyfimacho, Syriam Ptolemaeo, Babylonem Seleuco traderet, thesaurosque poft victum Eumenem fecum divideret) fuperbius refponderet, quadriennali bello occafionem dedit. Idea fortuna geftum eft, ut primo Polyclitus Seleuci Dux, Antigoni claffe potiretur; Antigonus fruftra tentata Aetolorum focietate, relicto contra Ptolemaeum & Seleucum Demetrio F. in Ciciliam tranfiret; altero occupata Peloponnefo, pacem Caffandro extorqueret; tertio fracta per Caffandrum pace, Demetrius a Ptolemaeo & Seleuco in Syria vinceretur, & Seleucus Babylonem cum Media & Sufiana miraculofo fucceffu reciperet; quarto, ejecto ex Syria per Demetrium Ptolemaeo, & occupata per eundem Babylone, ducto in Arabiam infeliciter ab Antigono exercitu, pace fimulata, Caffander Europae, Lyfimachus Thraciae, Ptolemaeus Aegypti, Africae, & Arabiae, Antigonus Asiae totius fummus Dux haberetur.
main_text.head: CONTEMPORANEA.
main_text.p: JVDAEAM Ptolemaeus, victo ad Gazam Demetrio Antigoni F, fibi fubjecit; Hierofolymam ipsi fpecie facrificaturi ingreffus, Judaeis Sabbathi reverentiâ pugnare nolentibus, eandem occupavit, & novum Graecorum imperio initium praebuit,

page.notes: Marginal notes at left are mostly illegible (marginal letters and small references). Right margin note: "ASIATICA" with "Iosephi lib. 13. c. 7. & 12."; the scan is damaged at the bottom of the right page edge.
